import random
import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rnd = random.Random(seed)
n = rnd.randint(1, 8)
k = rnd.randint(1, n)
lines = [f"{n} {k}"]
for _ in range(n):
    s = rnd.randint(0, 19)
    e = rnd.randint(s + 1, 20)
    lines.append(f"{s} {e}")
print("\n".join(lines))
